label: It is impossible that there be no mover that is not MOVED_BY_ANOTHER_2, by Well-founded-induction
meaning: Suppose every mover is moved by another. Something is moved, so it has a mover. By induction along the series of movers moved by another, no mover exists: a mover's mover is another mover, also moved by another, hence a link of the series. The induction uses an additional accessibility commitment, not the source claim prohibiting infinitely many distinct movers.
